[Customer declined: 'I'm not gonna book it right now but I will give you a callback.'] — Rep then asked 'Did you have any other questions for me at the moment?' but never reasked or clarified next steps to lock the rate or explicit follow-up.

top_strength: Rep nailed the estimate anchor (range + personalization) and delivered a strong Meet Your Mover differentiator with specifics about background-checked, in-house crews with photos and bios on the website.
coaching_note: Critical miss: never asked the agenda question ('What are your biggest concerns and what do you want answers to?') — this is the single highest-priority line in the script and the foundation for discovery. Also missing: no communication differentiator (day-before call, crew lead name, inbox updates) and no rate-lock close or explicit rebook ask after the customer declined to book.
